Subject: ACME PO: tiered commit & reseller margin confirmation

Hi Sarah / ACME procurement team —

Following our call this morning, attaching a draft PO and the SKU mapping worksheet so we can lock the tiering and reseller split for the private offer. High level ask from ACME: a 3-tier committed spend schedule with increasing seat discounts and a single reseller (ResellCo) margin line item.

Attached: PO_Draft_ACME.pdf (draft) and sku_map_v2.xlsx (current mapping).

Two quick clarifying questions for internal and ACME alignment:
- Can ResellCo receive a fixed margin % applied to list price line items in the PO (rather than a separate rebate)?
- ACME wants a price lock for 24 months but will accept annual CPI adjustment if needed — does that work from our side for a private offer?

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood to confirm margin treatment + finalize SKU tiers by Friday 8/28
2) ACME to confirm PO terms and signature workflow (DocuSign link requested)

Thanks — I’ll loop Marcus for legal/finance and Aditya for SKU-level mapping.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop

Subject: Re: ACME PO: tiered commit & reseller margin confirmation

Lauren / Sarah —

Thanks for the context — I reviewed sku_map_v2.xlsx and annotated recommended SKU groupings. Short answers first:
- Reseller margin: technically we can surface a fixed margin line item in the PO, but Marketplace rules for AWS/GCP require the private offer to present list price + customer discount; the reseller often gets paid by the partner invoice flow. To make this clean for ACME and ResellCo, I recommend: include a "Partner commission" line in the PO at the agreed %-of-list and document in the SOW so procurement has visibility.
- 24-month price lock: OK from engineering/ops if we add an annual CPI clause capped at 3% / year. Legal will want to avoid multi-year list changes that affect reseller calculations.

SKU notes (high level):
- Group A (core inference): reserve dedicated capacity SKU, map to 4:1 seat equivalence for pricing tiers.
- Group B (embeddings + batch): priced per-1000 units, include a usage cap per tier to keep overage predictable.
- Group C (support & premium SLO): flat monthly line item.

I'll attach my annotated SKU sheet in a follow-up — Marcus, anything from finance/legal we should flag now?

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Team —

I reviewed the draft PO and Aditya's SKU grouping. A few legal/finance notes before we surface a partner commission line in the PO:
- We should avoid language that makes Redwood contractually liable for paying the reseller directly from our invoicing stream. Better to phrase as "Partner commission to be paid by Customer to ResellCo per the Partner Agreement" and attach the ResellCo master services addendum to the PO.
- If ACME insists on a margin baked into Redwood's price, we need to add a contract appendix that specifies calculation and audit rights for 24 months.
- CPI cap at 3% looks fine but include an exception clause for cloud pass-through charges (e.g., if underlying cloud pricing changes materially).

I'll prepare a short memo for Sarah that outlines the preferred options (attached: reseller_margin_memo.docx). If ACME requires Redwood to commit to paying ResellCo, we need a signed ECA (escrow/commission agreement).

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations & Legal (acting)
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: reseller_margin_memo.docx (Word, 12KB)

Subject: Re: ACME PO: tiered commit & reseller margin confirmation

Thanks Lauren / team —

Appreciate the clarity. ACME is comfortable with the following compromise:
- ResellCo to receive a fixed 7% margin applied to list price line items if Redwood includes a visible "Partner commission" line in the PO.
- ACME accepts Redwood's 24-month price lock with CPI cap + cloud-pass-through exception.
- In return ACME asks for a 60-day SLA credit clause tied to verified downtime on the dedicated SKU (we can accept a billing credit up to 1% of monthly committed spend per incident, capped at 6% annually).

We can proceed on those terms if Redwood confirms the commission treatment is OK and provides the DocuSign PO for signature. Also please share the finalized SKU map with the seat equivalence columns — ResellCo needs that to finalize their margin calculations.

Best,
